scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm run test && npm run build && npm run check:backend
scripts.check:backend: uv run --frozen ruff check packages apps/api apps/worker migrations tests/backend && uv run --frozen ruff format --check packages apps/api apps/worker migrations tests/backend && uv run --frozen mypy && uv run --frozen pytest -m "not integration"
scripts.data:lol:sync: docker compose --env-file .env.docker run --rm --no-deps worker metiquo-worker sync-lol-catalog
scripts.data:oracle:sync: docker compose --env-file .env.docker run --rm --no-deps worker metiquo-worker sync-oracles-elixir
